description: Source code for configuring and controlling digital signals (specifically a red LED) in the IoHwAb module for the MPC5567 microcontroller, including functions for setting, getting, and managing digital signals with control states.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Set_Digital_DigitalSignal_Red_Led
methods.description: Sets the digital signal for the red LED, updating the hardware channel and status.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Dcm_DigitalSignal_Red_Led
methods.description: Handles control commands for the red LED signal, such as returning control, resetting to default, freezing state, and short-term adjustments.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Set_Digital
methods.description: Public interface to set a digital signal based on the signal type.

methods.name: IoHwAb_Get_Digital
methods.description: Public interface to get the current level of a digital signal.
